notes.title: KATANA PUNK UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[h1]YEEAAAAAAAAAA![/h1][p]
Welcome to one major Katana Punk Update, featuring Blood, Parallax Scrolling, and Stores!

[/p][h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2][p]  [/p][p][b]2 NEW SHOPS[/b]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Mini Mart[/b] – Buy passive items. This shop lets you pick and choose the passives you want for the rest of your run.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/91ab0be5aa9d12d6f93a2bda493a269269144593.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/b89881859f7b820a2972b2f7461ef49a3adb2bc3.png"][/img][b]Eight Eleven[/b] – “Open 8 days a week!” (-Catboi!)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/49a9ee830f93e8e65db951ba5b086249690288cb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Modifies your [u]starting[/u] cards.[/i]

[i]Examples[/i]
Give your starting “Slash” cards: [i]Gain Critical Hit.[/i][/p][p]
or

Give your starting Armor cards: Discard [i]this card. Gain 1 Mana.[/i]   

[i]Oscar: Being able to discard your starting cards for mana or give Slash cards crit to enable crit builds sounds fun. These cards usually suck once you draft enough new ones, so this helps them mesh with the build you’re pursuing.[/i]

[b]NEW EVENT – Lil Shop[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/5f2865f7e2f2f6ea96308f1c5e5cadf408ef39dd.png"][/img] What a cute little SHOP!

...LETS STEAL HIM WITH US!!

[/p][p]Adds the [i]Lil Shop[/i] card to your deck.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/5edb014c9b32c4889e15d0757c7e9cc992aaebaa.png"][/img][/p][p]NOW THAT MONEY Is actually valuble for ONCE! I wanted you to have a ton of different ways to spend it! Ho wmuch is that 1 yen worth to you. What if I bribe you with 20 Glass Attack for this one combat only, so you can kick this enemy's ass! [/p][p][/p][p]What about coughing up 3 yen to 10 freaking cards in a boss fight!  Or what if you just permanently upgrade some red cad in your hand permanently, for only 1 yen! Now we're talking!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/220440bbb6af6dadd846221705d8f552eb3c4f4a.png"][/img][/p][p]Shop can only be entered once per combat so chose your upgrade carefully.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[b]MAP UPDATES[/b]
[i]Chest areas and Card Removal shops no longer appear on the main dungeon path; they are now exclusive to secret rooms.[/i] [/p][p][/p][p]Chests are Valuable as hell, they will no longer appear in the main route to make SPACE for the other shops.[/p][p][/p][p][b]STARTING DECK[/b]  [/p][p][/p][p][b]Assassinate[/b] now has a 50% chance to be replaced by [b]My First Katana[/b] at the start of a run.

This card in your starting deck[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/dade1909d200c1ba307cb434dca428d0cfe049ce.png"][/img][/p][p]
Might be this instead [/p][p][/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/908b57ac326e2105d788de98c46975be7b21ecba.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Yeah, that’s right! I’m swapping your starting deck. Katana Punk’s mission is to make every run unique. And to deliver on 1,000 hours of replay value! Not even your starting deck is safe. I’m all in!   [/p][p][/p][h2]CARD CHANGES[/h2][p] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Fickle Bee[/b]  Now grants Critical Hit until the end of turn after you play a yellow or pink card.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Surveil[/b] (added to starting deck)

Deal 15 damage. +5 damage for each secret room discovered this run.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578465/595d2203833935e4e81b79ee155b074b1eecaa20.png"][/img][/p][p]
\[][b]Polish[/b]

[strike]Old:[/strike] Give a random water card in your hand [i]repeat[/i].
[u]New:[/u] [b]Cycle 2[/b] [i]or[/i] give a random water card in your hand [i]repeat[/i]. 

Cycle 2 - Pay 1 Mana, discard this card: draw 2 non‑mana cards. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Blue Slash[/b]  [/p][p][strike]Old:[/strike] Deal 30 damage. If you played a water card [b]this turn[/b], repeat.
[u]New:[/u] Deal 20 damage. If you played a water card [b]this combat[/b], repeat.

[i]Honestly easier to trigger, so it should just lead you to being able to use this card a little bit more.[/i] [/p][p]
[/p][h2]QUALITY OF LIFE[/h2][p]  [/p][p][/p][list][*][p]90% of cards now render with 3D depth when rotated. Redrawing all those backgrounds and having them rotate, took such a long time but it looks so good. JUST LAUNCH THE GAME ALREADY AND LOOK AT IT![/p][/*][*][p]Bombs and compasses flash in the overworld when you reach max capacity. \[[/p][/*][*][p]Buff and debuff icons flash more for clearer feedback. [/p][/*][*][p]The Overclock icon now shows remaining overclocks each turn.  [/p][/*][/list][h2]BUG FIXES[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a ton of bugs, and added more bugs to fix. [/p][p][/p][p]There are genuinely a lot of other changes I haven’t listed because I’m bad at writing my finished work. Get in here, see the game, and check it out. The game looks gorgeous there’s now rain in boss fights. Enjoy and have fun![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Major Katana Punk Update: Overclock, Card Reworks, and New Content!
notes.notes:
Hello, I did something crazy, I changed fundamental rules of the game and now you will notice you can play more cards each turn.


The theme of this Patch is:

WHERE ARE MY FREAKING MANA CARDS!!! / TOO MANY MANA CARDS!!!


Have you been affected by only having too many or too little mana card! Well don't you worry because the following changes have been made Just for you!


You now start with the passive: [i]Overclock[/i] in every run.

[b]Overclock[/b]
Once per turn, you may play one card without paying its mana cost, then Overclock it for the rest of the run.
Overclocking the same card twice disables that card for X number of combats.

[b]Why This Change?[/b]

[list]
[*] I really like the safety net it provides in early fights to protect you from getting mana-screwed, but you can also use Overclock aggressively in fights you went out of your way to make harder.
[*] Greedier options make the game more interesting. Do you Overclock early to stabilize or save it for a boss fight?
[*] Being greedy with resources is just fun. When you decide to use it is on you.
[/list]

[b]Starting Deck Changes[/b]

• [b]Grow[/b] has a new keyword:

[i]Grow[/i]: Give a random red card in your hand +30 Attack.
[i]+You may exile this card instead of playing it to gain 1 mana.[/i]

Grow often felt clunky when you didn’t have red cards in hand. That would be fine if you drafted it, but considering that it's in your starting deck, it was just too punishing for a decision I made for you.



New Keyword: Cycling.

• [b]Cycling added to 4 of the 8 mana cards in your starting deck.[/b]

[i]Cycling[/i]: Instead of playing this card, you may pay 1 mana, discard this card to draw 2 non-mana cards.
[*] This helps when you only draw mana cards, letting you dig for armor or damage instead.



• [b]Removed 2 armor cards[/b] from your base deck.
• [b]Added 2 Bento Box cards[/b] to your starting deck.

Bento Box
Gain 15 Armor or 3 Eat Tofu.

[i]Eat Tofu (3 uses): Instead of playing this card, you may discard it to draw 3 cards. Permanently remove 1 Eat Tofu from this card each time.[/i]

Modifying your cards mid-run is one of Katana Punk’s best features. Like I said the theme here is to play as greedy as you want. Do you want to consume the Bento Box in a hard fight to improve 2 mana cards, or a mid-boss to get better rewards.


[b]Pet Rework[/b]

Busy Bee
• [b]Old[/b]: Increase your crit chance by 15% after doing damage.
• [b]New[/b]: After playing a yellow or pink card, your next damage will crit.



[b]New Event: Pho Shop[/b]

Spend 3 yen to buy a bowl of pho, granting a good random keyword to a random card.

You can also steal it if you don’t have money but that might backfire.



- Replaced the Wheel of Keywords with events that instantly upgrade random cards with keywords.
The wheel animation was too long, this is my attempt to speed up these two events.




[b]Keyword Reworks[/b]

After many playthroughs, I found some keywords weren't pulling their weight. Here are major changes:

Dress to Kill → Lipstick
• [b]Old[/b]: If you have 30 Glass Attack, play this card twice.
• [b]New[/b]: Gain Armor equal to this card’s Attack.

Dress to Kill felt too conditional and rarely satisfying. Lipstick is op af, it's going to be much more expensive but satisfying if you can get it.

Midas Touch
• [b]Old[/b]: When this card kills: Gain 1 yen for each pet you own.
• [b]New[/b]: When this card kills: Gain X yen. (X = number of Midas Touch stacks on this card)

Now simpler and more scalable. Base Midas starts with 2 stacks, so it’s easier to start farming.

Crit Curse
• [b]Old[/b]: Crit but deal 50% damage.
• [b]New[/b]: Crit but deal 75% damage.

Crit Curse is an enabler for cards that benefit from crit triggers. The old version felt like there was no reason to get it in non-crit builds. This change lets you maintain synergy while still being ok in non-crit builds.


Vampire Fangs
• [b]Old[/b]: When this card kills an enemy, gain 15 health. Exile after use.
• [b]New[/b]: When this card kills an enemy, gain 30 health. (No longer exiles on kill)



[b]New Card: Salmon Hosomaki[/b]

At the start of each turn, add 1 mana.
Cost: 4
This card has 2 [i]Finality[/i].

[i]Finality[/i]: You may play this card without paying its mana cost. If you do, remove 1 Finality. If no Finality remains, permanently remove the card.

[b]Enemy Balance Update[/b]

All enemies have been rebalanced.
They have more health and deal more damage to compensate for Overclock being available from the start.

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]

• Drafted mana cards now appear at the bottom of your deck when viewing cards.
• If you try to play a pet and have no open slots, it now replaces your oldest pet.


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

• Crit animation now correctly turns off at the end of your turn.
Too many to count and list here, sorry Bug Fix Fans.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
YOU HOT PERSON READING THIS!!!

YOU BEAUTIFUL HUMAN BEING! YEAH I'M TALKING TO YOU! YOU CAN'T ESCAPE MY GAZE YEAH YOU!
I am here to tell you straight up to your FACE that I am grateful as hell for helping Katana Punk's first public playtest.


I'm a firm believer that Roguelike's secret sauce all lie in the help that the community surrounds it. Here is a list of the first Update to Katana Punk:


[h2]🎮 Gameplay Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Summoning a pet while having no more room of pets [b]replaces your oldest pet[/b] instead of doing nothing.
[*]Starting deck now includes +1 [b]Explore[/b] card.
[/list]



[h2]🐱Pet Changes[/h2]

[h3]🦅 Crow (formerly Carpe Diem)[/h3]
[b]Old Name:[/b] Carpe Diem  
[b]Old Duration:[/b] 3 turns  
[b]Old Effect:[/b] Add a card to your hand from your most common tribe. Give it [i]Evaporate[/i].

[b]New Name:[/b] Crow  
[b]New Duration:[/b] 5 turns  
[b]New Effect:[/b] Add a card from your most popular tribe. It costs -1 Mana this turn.

[i]Dev Note:[/i] Crow was severely underperforming compared to other pets. This should give him stronger tempo potential without overpowering his identity.



[h3]🐚 Shelly[/h3]
[b]Old Duration:[/b] 3 turns  
[b]Old Effect:[/b] +10 Dexterity while active. Armor is retained.

[b]New Effect:[/b] +20 Dexterity while active. Armor is retained.

[i]Dev Note:[/i] I want Shelly to be a strong enabler for Earth build payoffs. I'm increasing how much armor she gives when you play blue cards to solidify her identity as an enabler.



[h3]🔥 Pako[/h3]
[b]Old Duration:[/b] 5 turns  
[b]Old Effect:[/b] Gain 10 Attack after performing a crit.

[b]New Effect:[/b] Gain [b]20 [/b]Attack after performing a crit.

[i]Dev Note:[/i] As a crit payoff pet, I wanted Pako to feel rewarding when you get a crit with him. Right now, his damage is lower compared to other payoffs, so I'm increasing his power to help him stand a chance with other pets that don't need as much to work.



[h3]🐝 Busy Bee → fickle Bee[/h3]
[b]Old Name:[/b] Busy Bee  
[b]Old Duration:[/b] 5 turns  
[b]Old Effect:[/b] When you play a Yellow card, increase your crit chance by +50% until you crit.

[b]New Name:[/b] Yellow Bee  
[b]New Duration:[/b] 4 turns  
[b]New Effect:[/b] When you play a Yellow card, your next damage source is a guaranteed crit.

[i]Dev Note:[/i] I'm removing the 50% random element from this card. And I'm making it guaranteed instead. This is to ensure the crit payoffs cards are safe. I'm also giving you one more explore card to help this bee trigger a little more with her new identity.



[h3]🐟 Salmon Sally[/h3]
[b]Old Effect:[/b] Gain 1-6 Glass Attack when you play a mana card.  
[b]New Effect:[/b] Gain 1-7 Glass Attack when you play a mana card.
[i]Dev Note:[/i] Honestly, Salmon Sally gets out of hand pretty quickly, but the randomness does keep it in check a little. I'm going to see if this change makes her too broken.


[h3]🦇 Batty Bat[/h3]
[b]Old Duration:[/b] 4 turns  
[b]Old Effect:[/b] Gain +100% Crit Damage after playing a Blue card.


[b]New Duration:[/b] 3 turns  
[b]New Effect:[/b] Gain +75% Crit Damage after playing a Blue card.

[i]Dev Note:[/i] This pet was underpicked before the Playtest, I overbuffed it to see if it would be picked. It turned out to be one of the strongest pets. I'm bringing him down a little to keep his power closer to the other pets.


[h3]🦝 Tanuki[/h3]
[b]Old Duration:[/b] 2 turns  
[b]Old Effect:[/b] All damage always crits.

[b]New Duration:[/b] 1 turn  
[b]Effect unchanged[/b]

[i]Dev Note:[/i] Tanuki was warping Fire builds due to how easy it was to burst across 2 turns. This keeps his power but limits his consistency early game.




[h2] 🃏 Card Changes[/h2]

[h3]🪶 Murder of Crows (Card)[/h3]

[b]Old Level 1:[/b]  
Cost: 1 🏮  
Deals 20 🔪 damage  
+10 per pet played this combat  

[b]New Level 1:[/b]  
Cost: 1 🏮  
Deals 10 🔪 damage  
+25 per pet played this combat  

[b]Old Level 2:[/b]  
Deals 20 🔪 damage  
+20 per pet played this combat  

[b]New Level 2:[/b]  
Deals 10 🔪 damage  
+35 per pet played this combat  

[i]Dev Note:[/i] This now scales way harder into pet-heavy builds while staying weak early. It gets out of hand quickly but this should help it snowball.


[h2]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Rest sites no longer hide card rewards on repeats.
[*]Fixed: Game pausing incorrectly during dungeon events and mystery rooms.
[*]Fixed: Multiple enemy rooms no longer spawn on top of each other.
[*]Fixed: Keyword Shop buttons no longer overlap; limited to 3 keywords.
[*]Fixed: Shop names appearing in the “See Deck” menu from the overworld.
[*]Fixed: "\n" now properly removed from UI text.
[*]Fixed: Keywords not appearing in library map view.
[*]Fixed: Pause menu no longer accessible during “mystery” room choice screen.
[*]Fixed: Crashes when viewing enemy intent or resolving damage.
[*]Fixed: Veterinarian shop could upgrade un-upgradable pets.
[*]Fixed: Opening audio settings no longer unintentionally changes volume.
[*]Fixed: Keywords and cards now draw in the correct screen position.
[*]Fixed: Overworld no longer creates overlapping room nodes.
[*]Fixed: The “LOYAL DOG” passive now correctly applies only to your first chosen pet.
[/list]


[h2]🧩 UI / QoL Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added: [b]Quit[/b] button to menus.
[*]Added: [b]Discord link[/b] in main menu.
[*]Added: You can now [b]hold Left Mouse Button to drag the map[/b] across the overworld.
[*]Added: [b]Sick flames everywhere[/b]. No balance impact. Just vibes.
[*]Improved: Made enemy reaction face zoom-ins darker for less retina damage.
[*]Improved: Transition flame effect is now darker and easier on the eyes.
[*]Improved: Enemy hitbox is now larger when they’re the only one left.
[*]Improved: Fixed overlapping cards on BACK/EXIT buttons and UI menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes 4/29/25
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

Thank you very much for your honesty and feedback.

Now Day 1 after release it's my promise to hear you and fix anything you might report.

The quickest way to contact me is always going to be through [url=https://discord.gg/wally]discord[/url].

Thank you, and I hope you have a wonderful day.

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a Quit button.[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the [b]LOYAL DOG[/b] passive to apply to all pets instead of just the first chosen pet.
[*]Fixed a bug where [b]CURSED[/b] cards would not tick down each combat.
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed shops and keyword shops to exceed the maximum number of items allowed.
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the deck from discarding properly.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the card [b]Through the Shadows[/b] to not be played.
[*]Fixed a bug where enabling [b]Fullscreen[/b] on startup could cause the game to become unresponsive.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the [b]"First Run"[/b] screen to always appear on the first title screen.
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Gave a name to the spider miniboss.
[/list]
